writes_not_tried.device_ioctl: a device's own commands need a device opened: the wall lets nothing new be opened outside the paths it was given (reads_outside), and the probe opens no device and sends no command to one
writes_not_tried.move_between_folders: the probe tries every kind in one folder, so it moves nothing into another; a move or a link into another folder makes a name there, which Landlock asks as the make rights that the make kinds show refused in the probe's folder
writes_not_tried.rename_within_folder: the probe renames nothing; a rename within one folder makes the new name and removes the old one, which Landlock asks as the make and remove rights that the make and remove kinds show refused
writes_not_tried.change_owner: the filter refuses every call that changes a file's owner, by path and by descriptor; the probe tries one call of the filter's list of changes to a file's attributes, a change of mode (metadata_change), and not this one
writes_not_tried.change_times: the filter refuses every call that changes a file's times, by path and by descriptor; the probe tries one call of the filter's list of changes to a file's attributes, a change of mode (metadata_change), and not this one
writes_not_tried.change_extended_attributes: the filter refuses every call that sets or removes a file's extended attributes, by path and by descriptor; the probe tries one call of the filter's list of changes to a file's attributes, a change of mode (metadata_change), and not this one
writes_not_tried.write_through_open_descriptor: Landlock checks a file when it is opened, so a file opened for writing before the wall can still be written through; the probe writes through none, and names each such file it finds open (descriptors_open_for_write), which a proven record holds empty
writes_not_tried.write_beneath_other_folder: the probe tries every kind in one folder only: a rule that granted write rights beneath another folder would not show here; apply_wall adds rules with read and execute rights only
